text: {"v":1,"mode":"lesson","intent":"Illustrate the dynamics of a spring–mass system","scene":{"family":"drawing"},"steps":[{"caption":"A wall supports a spring attached to a mass.","draw":[{"op":"line","from":[80,90],"to":[80,270],"id":"wall"},{"op":"polyline","points":[[80,180],[110,180],[125,155],[145,205],[165,155],[185,205],[205,180]],"id":"spring"},{"op":"rect","origin":[205,145],"size":[90,70],"id":"mass"},{"op":"label","target":"spring","text":"spring"},{"op":"label","target":"mass","text":"mass"}]},{"caption":"The mass oscillates as the spring pulls it toward equilibrium.","draw":[{"op":"line","from":[170,250],"to":[350,250],"id":"equilibrium"},{"op":"arrow","from":[300,180],"to":[350,180],"id":"motion-right"},{"op":"arrow","from":[200,180],"to":[150,180],"id":"motion-left"},{"op":"label","target":"equilibrium","text":"equilibrium"},{"op":"label","target":"motion-right","text":"motion"}]}],"claims":[],"takeaway":"A spring–mass system converts spring restoring force into back-and-forth oscillation around equilibrium."}
